memory_order: stable sort by retained strategy score descending, then frozen base generator order
winner_rule: candidate passes the frozen objective and repository regression checks
causal_pass_rule: retained-memory arm reaches a passing candidate within 64 charged candidates, exact winner replay passes, and the same first passing candidate has a strictly later rank under the no-memory control order.
objective_freeze_rule: Issue body and source may be inspected only after this protocol is committed; evaluator and regression command set must then be frozen before either arm is executed.
claim_boundary: A3 DEVELOPMENT only. A pass establishes causal reuse of one retained search prior on one fresh external task.
